name: Wager Hook
summary: An immutable canonical ETH/WAGER pool where ordinary swaps use empty hook data, exact-input swaps may optionally create fixed-odds WETH wager tickets, and randomness is requested only after the season closes for later settlement.

integration.standardSwapBehavior: Empty hookData remains an ordinary swap. The optional wager path uses exact 36-byte versioned hookData and the dedicated router; routed Uniswap trades can use the ordinary path without enabling the wager feature.

dedicatedRouter.purpose: Required only for the optional wager flow that binds a WETH stake to executed swap volume.

hookData.emptyDataBehavior: Empty hookData selects the unrestricted ordinary forwarded-sender path and creates no wager.

officialUniversalRouter.notes: The ordinary empty-data lane may be structurally compatible, but no exact Robinhood Universal Router address, code hash, four-quadrant fork test, or wallet-final settlement evidence is supplied.

multihop.notes: No current Universal Router multihop evidence has been supplied, and the optional wager flow remains dedicated-router-only.

quoteDiscovery.notes: The hook does not implement the Uniswap ALF indicative-quote interfaces.

finalAmountEvidence.notes: No exact router event plus wallet-delta reconciliation has been supplied for either ordinary or wager-enabled swaps.

dependencies.name: Production randomness provider
dependencies.notes: No target-chain provider has been evidenced for Robinhood Chain. The integration remains blocked until the provider and trust model are selected and reviewed.

callbackSemantics.name: afterInitialize
callbackSemantics.reentrancyBoundary: The canonical launch factory initializes the one configured pool; no arbitrary post-initialize external call is intended.
callbackSemantics.gasBoundary: No independent callback gas cap is evidenced.

callbackSemantics.name: beforeSwap
callbackSemantics.reentrancyBoundary: Forwarded-sender authorization is branch-dependent: empty data is unrestricted, while an exact 4-byte WAGER_DATA_VERSION plus 32-byte pendingId requires the immutable wager router and binds a staged wager to the same-block exact-input swap.
callbackSemantics.gasBoundary: The wager payload is exactly 36 bytes; the callback gas ceiling remains unmeasured.

callbackSemantics.name: afterSwap
callbackSemantics.reentrancyBoundary: Forwarded-sender authorization is branch-dependent: empty data is unrestricted, while nonempty wager data requires the immutable wager router. A wager-enabled swap creates a ticket and reads the immutable WETH balance for solvency; it does not request randomness.
callbackSemantics.gasBoundary: Ticket creation and the WETH solvency read need target-chain measurement. Randomness is requested later, outside PoolManager callbacks, after the season closes.

security.authorityModel: The source describes no mutable administrator, pause, upgrade, rescue, odds-change, or dependency-replacement path after launch.
knownRisks: The repository states that it is unaudited and not ready for real-value deployment.
The Robinhood Chain path has no evidenced production randomness provider; changing away from Chainlink VRF requires a new dependency and trust-model review.
Wager solvency and settlement depend on reserve accounting and the selected randomness provider's lifecycle behavior.
A real-money wager product requires jurisdiction-specific product and legal review before public launch.
